title: Election report of Indiana 1998 (general election statistics), scanned by the Indiana State Library

note: Leaves are ContentDM item ids (report pages 42 to 49): Secretary of State 3135 to 3136, Auditor of State 3137 to 3138, Treasurer of State 3139 to 3140, Clerk of the Supreme Court 3141 to 3142 (each office is two pages with the TOTALS row on the second).
